bias.en: Uptrend under pressure · back above the 5-day average
bias.zh: 上升趋势承压 · 重回 5 日均线上方

read.en: AMD rose 3.4% on Oct 21 to $552.72, trading between $537.30 and $556.79. It is above the falling 5-day ($543.3), rising 100-day ($526.7) and rising 200-day ($399.1) averages, but below the falling 10-day ($571.6) and rising 30-day ($582.3). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 9 and is below zero, with the histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 8 ($587.03), and RSI is 45.
read.zh: AMD 10月21日上涨 3.4%，收于 $552.72，盘中区间 $537.30–556.79。股价位于下行的 5 日（$543.3）、上行的 100 日（$526.7）和上行的 200 日均线（$399.1）上方，但低于下行的 10 日（$571.6）和上行的 30 日均线（$582.3）。MACD 自 10月9日起位于信号线及零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 10月8日起看空（$587.03），RSI 为 45。

read.en: The close cleared the $547–548 resistance (5-day average, Oct 20 high), which now becomes support. Resistance is $556.8 (Oct 21 high), then $567–571.6 (Oct 14 low and close, 10-day) and $582–587 (30-day, SAR). Support is $543–548, then $524.6–526.7 (Oct 20 low, 100-day) and $495–498. A close above $571.6 would target $582–587; a close below $524.6 would open $497.
